q: What happened to Buckingham after the departure of the queen who Martha Ann Ricks presented the famed Liberian coffee tree to?
gold_answer: palace was seldom used, even neglected
answer: After Queen Victoria departed Buckingham Palace following her husband Prince Albert's death in 1861, the palace was seldom used and neglected for many years. In 1864, a note was found pinned to its fence stating the premises were "to be let or sold, in consequence of the late occupant's declining business." The palace remained shuttered for most of the year, with court functions instead being held at Windsor Castle, until public opinion eventually forced the Queen to return to London.
